about.title: I'm Carol Rivero
about.text: Clinical psychologist and therapist specialized in mental health and emotional well-being. My approach is integrative: I combine Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy with Emotion-Focused Therapy to give you coping tools and work toward meaningful results.

education.label: Education
education.value: Universidad de Investigación de Bucaramanga, Colombia

experience.label: Experience
experience.value: Individual therapy, couples therapy and group processes
